HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.
- Tests: `bun test <your test path>` must pass and `bun test` (whole suite) must not regress. Never modify existing tests
  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.

TASK T57 · W1 · Sessions with no recorded rules still belong to a setup
GOAL: Three public repos (BbrSofiane/sof-pi, itsmeyaw/binden, entireio/forgemark) review as "0 setups": every session's rules hash is
null, so no session gets a setup id. Example: sof-pi's 51 sessions are all harness "Pi" with rules_hash null. Not having a rules file
is a real configuration, not an unknown one.
READ: src/identity/index.ts (identify, rulesAtParent, setupIdOf), src/ingest/parse.ts (rules_hash from transcripts),
reports/BbrSofiane__sof-pi/sessions.json for real shapes.
OWNS: src/identity/index.ts, tests/identity-norules.test.ts
BUILD: When the transcript records no rules, fall back to the rules files present at the parent of the session's first linked commit,
for any harness: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/*, .github/copilot-instructions.md. If none exist there, the rules
hash is the fixed sentinel sha256("no-rules-file") and rulesPath is "(none)". An empty model becomes "unknown-model" for the setup id,
so sessions still group by harness. Only a session with no linked commit and no transcript rules keeps setupId null.
ACCEPTANCE: tests: a Pi session with no rules in its transcript and no rules file at its parent gets a setup id equal to another such
session's; adding an AGENTS.md at the parent changes the id; existing identity tests pass.
TEST: bun test tests/identity-norules.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.
